ashby:9fin:839c010e-79f7-4d30-97a1-dbf40.summary:
9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

sections.title: About 9fin
paras: We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

sections.title: The opportunity
paras: The Account Management Team is at the forefront of building client relationships and driving revenue through enhancing clients’ workflows. Customer Success will be a newly created function and extension of our AM team. They will collaborate closely with the account managers and innovate on new ways to partner with the 9fin client base.
The role focuses on ensuring that our clients fully understand our product offering and seek to improve usage of our platform using data to drive innovative communication.

There is also a high degree of collaboration between other teams to execute the usage growth strategy; enhance our high quality, high functioning, great looking, easy to use products; and to produce a top-tier customer experience.

sections.title: What you'll work on
paras: Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:
bullets: Become a 9fin expert with a strong understanding of our products and services
Partner with the account managers on specific client projects to drive and ensure growth within the accounts
Become the voice of the client when delivering on internal projects by ensuring our clients’ needs are consistently met
Develop bespoke KPIs and strategies for accounts and introduce performance data driven insights to our clients
Leverage existing customer relationships and expand the network of relevant contacts within each account to ensure 9fin continues to be the partner of choice for their needs
Attend relevant industry conferences and events
Maintain up to date records of client interactions via our CRM

sections.title: Requirements
paras: This role will be a great fit if you have:
bullets: 6+ years of relevant account management or Customer Success experience (Capital Markets, B2B Sales or Business Development)
A strong knowledge of financial markets, and a demonstrated ability to build strong relationships within buyside, sellside & advisory community
A track record of managing & growing a book of enterprise clients (min $1m+ book of business)
Ability to plan and prioritize important tasks and work with accuracy and attention to detail
Effective written and verbal communication skills conveying messages accurately and concisely
Team player, but also able to work effectively alone (help is always at hand if you need though!)
Existing relationships / network within the Leveraged Finance community would be beneficial

ashby:afterquery:3e8161e3-52f1-403d-8742.summary:
AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Work closely with engineers, operators, and internal users to deeply understand their workflows and pain points
Identify the highest-leverage product and infrastructure problems across the company
Turn ambiguous problems into clear product direction and technical requirements
Partner with Engineering to ship products and systems quickly
Balance immediate business needs with long-term scalability and maintainability
Own product areas end-to-end, from problem discovery through launch and iteration
Use data, user feedback, and business context to prioritize what we build
Help standardize and improve workflows as AfterQuery scales

sections.title: Required Qualifications
bullets: Strong technical fluency; prior experience in software engineering, ML, or data is a strong plus
High ownership and ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments
Strong product judgment and ability to identify the underlying problem behind user requests
Excellent communication skills and ability to work across technical and operational teams
Bias toward action and comfort moving quickly with incomplete information
Strong user empathy and willingness to spend significant time understanding how people actually work
Ability to synthesize fragmented feedback into clear priorities and product direction

ashby:airwallex:345ac70c-c7ce-452c-92e4-.summary:
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told…

sections.title: What you'll do:
paras: As a Staff Product Manager, GTPN (Global Treasury & Payment Network), you will drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution for our customer-facing API platform, enabling global treasury and payment solutions at scale. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, sales, and leadership to deliver innovative, scalable, and secure API products that empower our customers and partners to build next-generation financial experiences. This is a high-impact, strategic role with the opportunity to shape the future of global payments and financial infrastructure. This role is based in San Francisco.

sections.title: Responsibilities:
bullets: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for GTPN APIs, from ideation to delivery and ongoing optimization.
Develop and champion the strategic vision and roadmap for the platform, balancing long-term innovation with short-term business needs.
Engage directly with enterprise customers, developers, and partners to understand their needs, gather feedback, and validate product features.
Translate complex use cases into scalable, secure, and intuitive APIs in collaboration with engineering teams.
Lead cross-functional teams—including engineering, design, sales, compliance, and data science—to deliver impactful solutions.
Use data-driven methods to define and measure success metrics, prioritize requirements, and communicate plans and launches.
Represent GTPN in strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and enterprise partners.
Mentor and lead other product managers, with the opportunity to grow into a broader leadership role.

sections.title: Who you are
paras: We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

sections.title: Minimum qualifications:
bullets: 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on platform/API products in fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure.
Proven track record of defining, building, and launching successful, scalable API-powered platforms or products.
Deep technical understanding of API design principles, security, and developer experience.
Experience considering both user requirements and commercial strategy to drive meaningful product growth.
Strong ability to manage trade-offs between long-term vision and short-term execution.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey product strategy to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfortable working in data-driven, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, global environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

ashby:arena:5cc3bdf7-1904-452f-9348-4e09.summary:
Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it.

Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do.

sections.title: About Arena Intelligence
paras: We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus.

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: Arena is looking for a Product Marketer to shape how millions of people understand, experience, and evaluate AI models in the real world. In this role, you will own the Arena narrative, helping clarify what the product does, why it matters, and how people should use it to evaluate and use frontier AI models for their actual real-world needs.

As a key member of the growing Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Product Marketing, you will sit at the intersection of product, data, community, and storytelling. Your work will directly influence how users discover Arena, how they move through the product, and how clearly they understand model strengths, tradeoffs, and use cases to keep our audiences engaged.

This is a high-impact role focused on making Arena intuitive, credible, and indispensable to knowledge workers that want to stay at the forefront of AI. You’ll translate complex systems—crowdsourced voting, dynamic leaderboards, model routing, and evaluation methodology—into clear value for users, while preserving the scientific rigor and academic precision that Arena is known for.

sections.title: Responsibilities:
bullets: Owning product positioning and messaging across Arena’s core product surfaces, ensuring users understand what Arena is, how it works, and why it’s trustworthy.
Defining and refining value propositions for Arena’s user experiences (e.g., direct model comparisons, leaderboards, voting, routing) grounded in real-world use cases.
Partnering with Product and Design to improve onboarding, navigation, and feature discovery for new and existing users.
Leading go-to-market efforts for launches, updates, and experiments—including launch messaging, in-product education, and external announcements.
Translating Arena’s evaluation methodology and data into clear, accessible explanations without oversimplifying or undermining credibility.
Developing frameworks to explain model differences, strengths, and tradeoffs in ways that help users make better decisions.
Collecting and synthesizing user insights, behavioral data, and feedback to inform messaging, product direction, and prioritization.
Collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Community to ensure consistency between what Arena is, what it does, and how it’s perceived.

sections.title: Requirements:
bullets: 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, or AI/Consumer/Developer Marketing roles, ideally in developer tools, SaaS, AI, or data-driven products.
Strong ability to translate complex technical or data-heavy systems into clear, compelling customer-facing narratives.
Proven experience partnering closely with Product and Design on onboarding, UX copy, and feature launches.
Track record of leading go-to-market efforts for key products or features.
Deep empathy for users and strong instincts for clarity, trust, and usability.
Excellent communication skills across written, verbal, and visual mediums.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly in an early-stage, fast-moving environment, attention to detail and organization are critical.
A proactive, self-directed work style with strong ownership and prioritization skills.

ashby:ashby:1290fe74-72f6-4544-ad7d-562f.summary: Hi 👋 I’m Rosalia , and I look after our Product Marketing team at Ashby. I started my career in Product Marketing and helped build the Sales Enablement function at HubSpot during its journey from startup to IPO. Since then, I've worked across RevOps and Customer Marketing at Procore and Meta, partnering with incredible teams to bring differentiated products to market. I first heard of Ashby through our Head of Content, Anum, with whom I'd spent those early days at HubSpot, and was inspired by the level of thoughtfulness and operating principles I saw and read about. sections.title: What we’re looking for
paras: We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own our Enterprise narrative, content and enable our go-to-market teams with clarity and confidence.

This includes the messaging, content, and sales support that helps us win and grow our largest, most complex customers. This role is about deeply understanding what it takes to sell and support Ashby at the Enterprise level: longer sales cycles, more sophisticated buying committees, and a much wider set of stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Analysts, Heads of Talent, RecOps, and more).

You'll partner closely with our Director of Product Marketing to make sure Enterprise messaging ladders up to Ashby's overarching company narrative, while you go deep on what makes that narrative land specifically with Enterprise and upper mid-market buyers. You will synthesize inputs from customer research, product direction, market dynamics, and company vision into clear, compelling narratives that scale across the segment.

sections.title: Your Background
paras: There's no perfect path into this role. We're open to a variety of backgrounds, including:
bullets: Product Marketing
Sales Enablement
Competitive Intelligence
Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering

sections.title: Own Enterprise segment narrative development
bullets: Conduct deep research and develop messaging for the full Enterprise buying committee: Finance, Legal, Analysts, Heads of Talent, RecOps, and other stakeholders that don't show up the same way in smaller segments.
Translate Ashby's company-level narrative into a story that resonates with Enterprise and upper mid-market buyers.
Maintain the Enterprise messaging framework that empowers Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to communicate, sell and service Ashby’s differentiation with confidence.

sections.title: Be a strategic partner to Enterprise sales
bullets: Partner deeply with Sales Leadership and Solutions Engineering to identify opportunities within the segment
Develop Enterprise-specific enablement and build campaigns and materials that support the Enterprise sales process.
Act as the source of truth and connective tissue between Marketing, CS, and Sales on how to speak to the Enterprise buyer, overall messaging and collateral
Deliver well-crafted trainings to sales in collaboration with other sales-supporting teams to move forward audience positioning and other key initiatives.

ashby:ashby:43095123-207d-4b0e-bcfe-3c66.summary:
Hi 👋 I’m Rosalia , and I look after our Product Marketing team at Ashby.

I started my career in Product Marketing and helped build the Sales Enablement function at HubSpot during its journey from startup to IPO. Since then, I’ve worked across RevOps and Customer Marketing at Procore and Meta, partnering with incredible teams to bring differentiated products to market. sections.title: Your Background
paras: There is not a single background that is the perfect fit for this role. We care more about the skills and intrinsic capabilities you bring to the table, and could see someone from a number of different backgrounds being a good fit, including:
bullets: A Solutions Engineer who loves narrative and wants to shape more than just demos
An Early-stage AE who worked closely with Product

sections.title: Release Products and Features
bullets: Own go-to-market planning and execution for feature releases across multiple product lines.
Work closely with Product Managers to shape value propositions, messaging, and demo strategies.
Produce polished feature videos for use across social media, the website, and other marketing channels.
Create assets including blog posts, one-pagers, demo videos, internal launch docs, and enablement materials.
Turn features into clear customer value through videos, product walkthroughs, and content that make the benefit obvious.
Partner with other product marketers on larger and bundled launches where support is needed.

sections.title: Keep the release engine moving and create leverage for your team
bullets: Serve as a product expert and go-to resource for how features work and how we position to the market.
Coordinate release promotion with Solutions Engineering, RevOps, Sales, CS & Support teams to ensure audiences across the organization are best-equipped through their channels.

Help maintain our product launch velocity by leveraging AI, automation, and building scalable systems to manage a high volume of releases, giving yourself time back for more high-leverage work.

sections.title: You Might Be a Fit If You
bullets: You’re highly organized, and can keep multiple releases, owners, and deadlines moving at once without anything slipping.
You’ve got an exceptional eye for detail - people consistently trust you as the final eye on something because you catch more than just typos every time .

You’re the person people ping and say, “Can you just explain this feature in normal words?” and you actually can.
You know how to shape a good demo or walkthrough that tells a story. Not just “click here, then here” but “here’s how this solves your problem.”
You are comfortable owning your own copy and collaborating with design teams to produce well-polished assets.
You can read a launch plan and immediately hear the voices of Sales and CS in your head “but what about XYZ?”, and you’ve already worked with technical and product teams for the answer.
You can follow a playbook but are not afraid to go back to first principles thinking and build something from scratch without much direction.

ashby:baseten:8c49e4ee-615d-4ef8-a189-8c.summary: Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F , led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

sections.title: PRODUCT AT BASETEN
paras: Baseten is building a new cloud for AI. Our ambition is to make inference, training, and agent execution part of one coherent platform, and to shape how the next generation of AI products gets built. Product decisions here reach from the economics of GPU infrastructure to the abstractions developers build on every day.

We’re hiring builders and tastemakers with the ambition to help create that future. You should bring a strong point of view about what should exist, the taste to make complex technology feel simple, and the technical judgment to build it alongside engineers, researchers, and designers. You’ll work directly with customers and forward deployed teams, turn emerging capabilities into new possibilities for developers, and carry an idea from early conviction through to production and adoption.

sections.title: Make world-class AI inference feel effortless for developers.
paras: Building with AI models should be easy. Getting them into production, understanding their performance, and scaling them reliably is anything but. At Baseten, we're changing that.
We're looking for a Product Manager to own the experience of building on Baseten, from discovering and evaluating models to deploying, optimizing, and operating them in production.

You'll help shape some of our most important products, including Model APIs, Dedicated Inference, Model Evaluations, and our Model Library. You'll work closely with engineering, research, and GTM to turn breakthroughs in inference performance into products that developers love and businesses depend on.

sections.title: RESPONSIBILITIES
bullets: Own product strategy and roadmap across Baseten's inference offerings, with a focus on developer adoption and business impact
Make it easier for developers to discover, evaluate, deploy, and manage AI models through our APIs, SDKs, CLI, and console
Work with inference engineers and researchers to turn technical advances into compelling customer-facing capabilities
Help determine which models, workloads, and customer needs we prioritize
Partner with GTM and leadership on pricing, packaging, launches, and commercialization
Spend time with developers and customers to understand what's working, what's frustrating, and what we should build next

sections.title: REQUIREMENTS
bullets: 10+ years building and shipping AI/ML products or platforms
A technical background in software engineering, ML engineering, research, or equivalent hands-on experience
Direct experience building or deploying models using technologies like PyTorch, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar frameworks
Strong understanding of model serving, GPU economics, and the tradeoffs between quality, latency, throughput, and cost
Exceptional developer product instincts. You know how to make complex technology approachable without sacrificing power
A track record of leading cross-functional product initiatives and turning technical capabilities into measurable adoption or revenue growth

ashby:beam-up:b11ea97d-5527-4909-97b7-81.summary:
At Beam, we’re building AI that serves society.

We're a global team of ambitious, hardworking problem solvers, applying fast-moving startup energy to work that makes the world a better place. If you want to apply your talent to the biggest problems society faces, Beam is the place for you.

You’ll be part of a high-performance culture where you'll make a huge impact, rapidly progress your career, and truly enjoy your work.

Over 120,000 frontline workers across 400+ customers already use Beam to take notes, provide live interpretation and handle phone calls, so they can focus on the people who need them most. This is just the beginning.

sections.title: About the role
paras: You'll sit within the Customer Success team, working directly with the frontline teams who use Beam every day and the operational leaders who run their services, mostly across the public sector as well as private and charity sector partners. You'll own how a portfolio of customers gets real value from Beam: knowing each account better than anyone, caring deeply about whether it succeeds, and doing whatever it takes to get it there. You'll work hand in hand with your Account Manager as one team on every account. They lead the commercial relationship and define what success looks like; you own how we get there.

sections.title: Owning customer success
bullets: Owning the plan for how each account hits the KPIs agreed with the customer, from activation through to sustained adoption and measurable impact, and seeing it through with urgency.
Acting as the main point of contact for users, project managers and operational leaders, and running steering calls that leave customers clear on progress, risks and next steps.
Choosing the right levers for each account, from champion networks, manager engagement and workflow changes to comms and training, delivered remotely and on site with customers across the UK.
Partnering with Account Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Product, Engineering and Support to remove blockers quickly.

sections.title: Knowing your accounts better than anyone
bullets: Understanding each team’s day-to-day workflows, usage and barriers, and digging into what sits behind the numbers.
Spotting disengagement and risk early, and leading the recovery plan.
Using data and stories from the frontline to show the impact Beam is having, and building the evidence with your Account Manager ahead of conversions, expansions and renewals.
Knowing Beam’s products inside out, and bringing in Forward Deployed Engineers when you need additional technical depth.

sections.title: Being the voice of the customer
bullets: Understanding how frontline teams work, what gets in their way and where Beam can make the biggest difference, and bringing that back to Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap.

Working side by side with your Account Manager on account strategy: sharing what you’re seeing on the ground, spotting risks and opportunities early and shaping the plan together, while they lead commercial conversations.

ashby:blockstream:6022d5f3-a6df-4581-9ba.summary:
Blockstream was founded in 2014 by Dr. Adam Back and a group of fellow cryptographers and engineers passionate about Bitcoin and its potential to change the future of finance. We have become a market leader in Bitcoin security and Layer-2 technologies. Our products are designed to make financial systems more efficient, secure, and robust.

We are seeking a Technical Solutions Consultant (Pre-Sales) , a customer-facing technical expert responsible for helping financial institutions evaluate, design, and adopt Blockstream's enterprise software solutions.

Operating within the Consulting Services organization, the Solutions Engineer partners closely with Enterprise Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to support the customer journey from technical discovery and solution architecture through product demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and technical validation.

sections.title: Customer Engagement & Technical Sales
bullets: Partner with Enterprise Sales to support strategic opportunities across financial institutions.
Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customers' business, operational, regulatory, and technical requirements.
Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects, Operations, and Engineering teams.
Deliver compelling product demonstrations, technical presentations, and solution walkthroughs.
Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), solution validation activities, and technical evaluations.
Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout the sales process.

sections.title: Solution Design & Architecture
bullets: Design end-to-end solution architectures leveraging Blockstream's enterprise software products.
Translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions and implementation approaches.
Define solution assumptions, integration approaches, deployment models, and technical dependencies.
Collaborate with customers to identify implementation risks and recommend best practices.

sections.title: Commercial & Deal Support
bullets: Lead or contribute to responses for RFPs, RFIs, technical questionnaires, and security assessments.
Support commercial discussions by providing technical expertise and solution positioning.
Help package Blockstream products into repeatable enterprise offerings, demonstrations, and implementation approaches.
Clearly communicate the value proposition and differentiators of Blockstream's products.

sections.title: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets: Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Security, Delivery, and Consulting teams.
Feed customer and market feedback back to Product Management.
Help improve demos, technical collateral, reference architectures, and solution playbooks.
Contribute to repeatable implementation methodologies and sales enablement materials.

ashby:bolt-farm:33d966c7-3e27-44c9-9025-.summary: You notice when someone stops showing up. You ask the question that uncovers what’s really holding them back. And you don’t confuse answering messages with helping someone make progress.

sections.title: What you’ll own
bullets: Turn new members into active members. Lead onboarding, clarify next steps, and help people engage with the community and their program instead of getting lost in a content library. After a purchase or upgrade, help them settle into the next stage with confidence.

sections.title: What’s in it for you
bullets: Real autonomy and hands-on ownership. Own the member journey, bring ideas forward, and improve how the business supports people. You won’t be waiting for permission to care or take initiative within your role.
Close access to the founders. Work directly with Seth and Tori, learn how they think about coaching, community, and business, and help bring their vision to life.
A role you can grow with. Learn a ton across customer success, retention, community building, and AI-enabled operations as Bolt Coaching grows.
Meaningful, visible impact. See members reach milestones because you helped them get unstuck, stay engaged, and take the next step.
A solid base with retention-based rewards. Your incentive is aligned with member success and retention, not pressure to close sales.
Complimentary staff stays at BOLT FARM Treehouse
Health stipend
Flexible time off

sections.title: You’ll thrive here if you
bullets: Have experience owning customer or member relationships, ideally in coaching, memberships, communities, or another high-touch service business.
Combine warmth with follow-through. You remember the details, ask thoughtful questions, and make sure commitments turn into action.
Can handle difficult conversations with empathy and clear judgment, including disengagement, dissatisfaction, and cancellation concerns.
Are organized and proactive, comfortable using participation data and member records to spot issues before they become bigger problems.
Embrace AI and automation while knowing that trust, nuanced conversations, and relationship ownership stay human.

ashby:canals:dd17c784-abba-4b2b-b355-16b.summary:

Our customers are the companies responsible for moving the materials that power the real economy; electrical supplies, plumbing products, roofing materials, HVAC equipment, and more. Lead the product and feature launch process

Manage communications to customers through marketing channels, e.g., email
Coordinate cross-functional teams to execute launch tactics
Create and maintain personas, product messaging, and positioning, based on the latest market insights and learnings
Translate messaging and positioning into marketing and sales assets, e.g., slide decks, campaign ads, thought leadership

sections.title: What We’re Looking For

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to take complex concepts and distill them into digestible, relatable, and easy-to understand writing
Strong cross-functional collaborator, works well with and can “speak the language” of Product, Sales, Customer Success, Support and more

ashby:causaly:bbf17b46-dee4-4ae8-aa83-ce.summary:
Causaly is redefining how humans acquire knowledge and develop insights in biomedicine. Our AI-powered platform enables researchers and decision-makers to discover and interpret evidence from millions of scientific publications, clinical trials, regulatory documents, and other complex data sources in minutes.

We are building the world’s most advanced biomedical knowledge platform, powered by a high-precision Knowledge Graph and GenAI capabilities. Our technology is already used by leading biopharmaceutical organizations to accelerate drug discovery, improve safety, and drive better decision-making.

Backed by top-tier investors including ICONIQ, Index Ventures, Pentech, and Marathon, we are scaling rapidly and expanding our product suite and market presence.

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: In this role, you will be a key contributor to Causaly’s revenue growth while inspiring change as a market game-changer. Reporting directly to our SVP Sales, you will work cross-functionally to build customer value and drive new business. You will have global ownership of the full lifecycle of a portfolio of top 50 global pharma enterprise customers. sections.title: Operating Principles
paras: Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:
We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.
bullets: Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.
Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.
Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.
Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

sections.title: AI-First by Default
paras: We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.
That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.
bullets: Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.
Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.
Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.
Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: The Scaled Team is how Deepgram delivers world-class customer success to our fastest-growing segment — at scale. Instead of one CSE per account, you'll drive adoption, retention, and expansion across a large, pooled portfolio through a digital-first, one-to-many motion: automated customer journeys, programmatic outreach, self-serve enablement, and well-timed human touchpoints at the moments that matter most.

This is a role for a deeply technical systems builder. You'll be as comfortable troubleshooting an API integration as designing the onboarding sequence, webinar, or automated workflow that helps hundreds of customers hit value faster. Your leverage doesn't come from how many meetings you take — it comes from the repeatable systems you build that make every customer feel like they have a dedicated engineer in their corner.

sections.title: Who You Are
paras: You're not a traditional CSM. You're a Customer Success Engineer who works at the intersection of APIs, customer outcomes, and scale — credible running demos, guiding integration and architecture decisions, and helping customers get from prototype to production. What sets you apart is the instinct to turn a one-off fix into something scalable: a playbook, an automation, a self-serve resource that solves the same problem for every customer who comes after. You've shipped something — an internal tool, an agent, a script, a pipeline, a customer-facing program — that permanently eliminated a class of problems for you, your team, or your customers.

You're energized by serving a high volume of customers without dropping the quality bar. You ramp quickly on unfamiliar accounts, prioritize ruthlessly through a business-impact lens, and are comfortable working a shared, pooled book rather than a fixed set of named accounts. You have high EQ and a high learning index — you read a customer's situation fast and absorb technical and business complexity faster. You write exceptionally well, because your writing has to scale across hundreds of customers at once. And you question the status quo: the fact that we do something a certain way isn't evidence it's the best way.

AI is how you work, not a tool you reach for occasionally. You've rebuilt a meaningful part of your workflow around it, and going back to the old way would feel like working with one hand tied behind your back. You'd refuse to.

ashby:hedra:8cd2294b-dee4-44ea-ad54-427c.summary:

sections.title: The Role
paras: As Product Marketing Lead at Hedra, you'll turn our technical capabilities into content that helps developers understand what they can build and helps sales teams win business. You'll own content strategy and hands-on production for our B2B, sales-led business, working closely with marketing, sales, product, and engineering.

Most of your time will go toward deciding what we should say, writing it yourself, and getting it into the hands of the right people. That includes technical product stories, customer case studies, use-case and comparison pages, launch content, and materials that help sales teams move buyers from initial interest through technical evaluation and purchase. You'll need to earn the trust of developers while making the value clear to the business leaders buying alongside them.

You'll also contribute to messaging and positioning, and bring customer and market insights back to the product. Those responsibilities support the core job: building a content program that makes a complex platform understandable, differentiated, and easier to buy.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Own content strategy and the editorial calendar. Prioritize the topics, formats, and distribution channels that address developer needs, buyer questions, active sales opportunities, and product launches.

Write and ship the work yourself. Produce product explainers, technical articles, customer stories, solution pages, competitive comparisons, launch emails, and other content that connects what Hedra does to a specific customer problem.

Build content for sales-led growth. Work with sales on decks, one-pagers, evaluation guides, and objection-handling materials. Understand where deals stall and create content that helps technical champions and business buyers move forward.

Develop credible technical stories. Interview engineers, researchers, and customers; read the documentation; and use the product. Turn architecture, model capabilities, deployment tradeoffs, and customer results into clear narratives without losing the details that matter.
Build customer proof. Find compelling use cases with sales and customer success, interview customers, and develop case studies grounded in their actual workflows and results.

Carry each story across channels. Adapt core content for the website, blog, email, LinkedIn, and sales outreach. Partner with video and developer-facing teammates on scripts, demos, and launch assets.

Improve content based on how it performs. Track qualified engagement, use in sales conversations, and contribution to pipeline and deal progression. Use feedback to improve the work, not simply increase publishing volume.
Contribute to messaging and positioning. Help sharpen how we explain Hedra's value, differentiation, and best-fit use cases, grounded in customer conversations and competitive research.

paras: Please include writing samples that show your developer-facing work, customer storytelling, or sales content. Tell us what you personally wrote, who it was for, and what it helped achieve.
bullets: 5+ years in B2B product marketing, with substantial ownership of content strategy and production for a sales-led business. Experience with AI, developer tools, APIs, or infrastructure is especially relevant.

Exceptional writing ability. A portfolio that shows clear thinking, strong narrative structure, and an ability to make complex products compelling. You can write a useful technical deep dive and a concise sales narrative, and explain the choices behind each.
Demonstrated success marketing to developers or technical buyers. You understand how these audiences discover, evaluate, and adopt products, and can show work that earned their attention and trust.

Strong technical fluency. You're comfortable reading API documentation, trying an integration, and discussing model quality, latency, cost, and reliability with engineers. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to understand the product well enough to explain it accurately and ask good questions.
Experience supporting sales teams through complex buying processes, including technical evaluations, multiple stakeholders, and the transition from a promising use case to a production deployment.

A track record taking content from research and first draft through review, publication, distribution, and improvement. You're comfortable working directly in publishing tools without a large support team.

sections.title: Who You Are
bullets: A writer and a builder. You enjoy doing the research, finding the story, and making the finished piece, not just creating briefs for other people.
Technically curious and precise. You can simplify an idea without overselling it or stripping away what makes it useful.
Commercially minded. You care whether your work helps the right customers understand, evaluate, and buy the product.
Self-directed, collaborative, and open to feedback. You can set priorities, ship consistently, and improve the work with sales and technical teammates.

Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

sections.title: Building the AI Infrastructure for Construction
bullets: Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.
Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.
The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.
PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.
We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.
This is one of those rare moments where product decisions directly influence how the physical world gets built.

sections.title: Location

sections.title: Role Overview
bullets: We're hiring a Product Manager, AI to own PermitFlow's core AI infrastructure and workflow agents. This is a role that will require UX and technical acumen to deliver high quality agents in a genuinely complex domain, while also up-leveling our core agentic infrastructure and data flywheel.

Submitting a permit means comprehending construction documents, extracting project details, confirming every requirement has been met and often filling in pdf forms. Errors compound across steps and a failed submission adds real cost for our customers as projects slow.

The ideal candidate will mix an exceptional history of product delivery with true experience building AI and Agentic infrastructure from the ground up. You ship quickly, instrument everything, hold a high quality bar, and stay close to the users of what you build.
This role reports directly to our Head of Product. We're hiring at Staff or Principal, with the level based on past experience and interview performance.

Define what "reliable enough to submit" means at both the field and submission level, and own the quality bar that gates release

Build a durable design system around our data flywheel, ensuring that users can easily provide feedback on our Agents & AI products

sections.title: Senior Product Manager II, Fraud & Identity (Remote – USA / CANADA)
paras: Do you get energized by thinking like a bad actor so you can build the products that catch them? Is turning good analysis into a shipped, prioritized roadmap the thing you're proudest of, more than the analysis itself? Then this is the role for you.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager II to lead fraud and identity/authentication together at Wrapbook; two domains that lean on the same signals and the same underlying infrastructure, and work best under one owner. You'll define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for how we detect, prevent, and respond to fraud, and how we verify and protect identity, across the full customer lifecycle. This is a hands-on, build-with-engineers role, not a hand-it-off-and-wait one.

Fraud and identity also touch other teams' domains (company setup, worker onboarding, vendor payments, and more), so you'll work across those wherever it's relevant, bringing your Fraud expertise to influence and orchestrate a holistic, seamless fraud and identity customer experience. You'll also partner with the Legal & GRC team with your solutions as you own the tech that powers Wrapbook's KYC and AML compliance. You'll guide fraud operations (triage, investigation, case handling), enabling your partners in the Client Operations org. You own the product decisions: what gets detected, prevented, and surfaced to customers, and in what order. You'll report to the Senior Manager of Product Management, Onboarding & Lifecycle.

sections.title: What you'll do:
bullets: Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for fraud and identity/authentication across the customer lifecycle — from prevention to detection to response.
Prioritize and sequence the joint fraud + identity roadmap, weighing input across the teams whose backlogs it depends on.
Work directly with engineers on scoring logic and rules. Read a schema, reason about what a signal actually discriminates, and tell a good-sounding signal from a useful one.
Turn analysis into decisions that ship. Write decision docs that carry a clear recommendation and get acted on — not a comprehensive list of options with no ranking.
Act as incident commander for fraud incidents, coordinating engineering, Client Ops, GRC, Treasury, and Security, and evolve the playbooks so others can step in.
Define and instrument the fraud and identity health metrics that matter most — spanning detection accuracy, authentication coverage, and the customer friction it creates.
Say no upward, with evidence, when a new signal, a vendor, or a broad enforcement change would spend the friction budget without reducing real risk.
Partner with Legal/GRC on the compliance-adjacent surface your product touches (KYC/AML posture, audit walkthroughs) without taking on the compliance function itself.

sections.title: What you'll have:
bullets: Owned a fraud, risk, or identity product surface at a payments, fintech, or marketplace company — not adjacent to it, owned it.
Real fluency in detection tradeoffs: precision vs. recall, the true cost of a false positive, and the idea of a finite friction budget.
Comfort working directly with engineers on scoring logic and schemas, not just briefing them and waiting.
Experience running or co-running incident response, with the instinct that the expensive part of fraud is the operational orchestration, not the detection build.
AI fluency/demonstrated experience working with/building with AI; using AI to increase the speed, accuracy, and automation throughout the fraud lifecycle.
A track record of decision docs that got decided and turned into shipped work, not just documented.
Experience in build/buy decisions around fraud platforms.
Comfortable pushing back on senior stakeholders with evidence, rather than deferring or complying by default.

sections.title: The role
paras: Pacaso buyers are high-net-worth individuals making a considered purchase over months, sometimes years. They move between our site, email, messaging, and our Sales team, and today each of those runs on its own tools with its own picture of the customer. We believe one personalized system that follows each customer from first interest to purchase, and keeps serving them as an owner, will shorten the path to purchase and make our growth product-led.

We're hiring a principal-level technical product manager to own that system and its outcome. You'll own the system-level design: the components, how they fit together, what the system decides and why, and how the AI agents behave. You'll own the roadmap, and you'll do hands-on work yourself: working prototypes built with AI tooling, UI design, and the prompts behind the agents. Engineering owns the technical design and implementation, and you shape and review it with them as it goes to production.

This is a technical product leadership role, not a backlog-management role and not a production engineering role. You'll make product calls with Sales, Marketing, and leadership, work through system tradeoffs with senior engineers, and be accountable for the outcome.

sections.title: What you'll own
bullets: The customer intelligence layer. What the system knows about each customer across channels and how it acts on it: signals, shared memory and context, scoring, eligibility and frequency caps, and the next-best-action logic that decides what happens next.
Agent and workflow design. Which agents exist, what each one is allowed to decide, how they hand off to each other and to Sales, and the prompts, tools, and orchestration behind them.
Trust and reliability. Evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, cost and latency budgets, and kill switches, in place before anything reaches a customer.
The path to autonomy. What the system decides on its own, what still needs a person, and the evidence we need before we take that person out of the loop.
The roadmap. What gets built in what order, and why. You set priorities across the site, email, messaging, the CRM, and Sales handoffs, and work with Engineering on build-versus-buy decisions.
The outcome. Funnel velocity (time from first interest to high intent, and to purchase) and the measured lift in qualified actions and closed sales.
An AI agent engages a new lead in the channel they prefer, qualifies them, and hands them to Sales at the right moment with the context Sales needs to close.
A customer reads an email, chats with us, and comes back to the site a week later. They get one continuous experience, because the system remembers what we've already said and done.

bullets: We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.

You'll own the strategy for ZoomInfo's person data, which is hundreds of millions of contact records used by more than 35,000 customers. We're moving from rule-based selection to AI agents that read the full evidence for each record, and you'll build the evaluation engine that decides whether their answers are good enough to publish. If you've shipped data pipelines and entity resolution at scale and use AI every day to improve data systems, you'll help define how we prove the new system is right.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own Person Data end to end, setting the strategy, roadmap, and monthly priorities for the accuracy, coverage, freshness, and compliance of contact data.

Build and run the AI evaluation engine: define "correct" for each attribute, curate golden sets and trap records, stand up LLM-as-judge gates, and set confidence thresholds that route records to auto-accept, auto-reject, or human review.

Drive the pivot from rules to agents by moving person attributes from deterministic selection to inference over full evidence, proving each step in shadow mode, and retiring legacy logic when the numbers support it.
Introduce models where they earn their place and keep classical tooling where it wins, weighing cost per row, latency, determinism, and auditability.
Solve entity resolution challenges, including person-to-company matching, wrong-company links, and duplicate people.
Own the person data privacy roadmap (suppression, opt-out, and notification) in partnership with Legal and Privacy.
Prototype adjudication agents, evals, and analyses in code alongside the AI engineer and data science team, and commit to the shared repository.
Partner across Person Data engineering, Match, Research, Data Science, Privacy, and application teams, and present the roadmap and its rationale to product and data leadership.

sections.title: What You Bring
paras: Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.
In addition to comprehensive benefits we offer holistic mind, body and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits here .
bullets: 8+ years of product management experience, including meaningful time owning data products or data platforms at scale

Direct experience with entity resolution, record linkage, or matching systems, including canonical IDs, match confidence, survivorship rules, and precision/recall trade-offs
Current, demonstrated use of AI to improve data systems, including bringing an LLM into a production data process while keeping accuracy from degrading

sections.title: Our guiding principles:

Excellence in execution. We know that what separates good from great is a high level of execution. We commit ourselves to excellence in everything that we do, from delivering an amazing product to writing a great email.
Act like an owner. We’re all owners of the business and act like it. We follow through on commitments, own our results and think long-term.

Fight for simplicity. The law of increasing functional information states that systems evolve to become more complex over time. At Quandri, we believe there is sophistication in simplicity; as such, we intentionally fight for streamlined solutions and are committed to the uncomplicated.

AI-first. We believe AI is a fundamental shift in how work gets done, not just a tool we occasionally reach for. The Community Partnership Manager serves as a primary ambassador for WorkSource Oregon and the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) program throughout Lane County. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining strategic relationships with community organizations, educational institutions, employers, and workforce partners to expand access to workforce services, increase WIOA enrollment, and improve participant employment outcomes.

The Community Partnership Manager leads community outreach, employer engagement, job development, workforce education, and partnership initiatives that connect job seekers with meaningful employment opportunities. This position works collaboratively with Case Managers, program leadership, and workforce partners to identify employment opportunities, secure job postings, facilitate employer referrals, and create pathways to employment…

sections.title: Job Description
paras: The position is also responsible for developing and facilitating job readiness workshops within the WorkSource Oregon job center and throughout the community. The Community Partnership Manager will coordinate with industry sector experts, employers, and workforce partners to provide specialized training, career exploration opportunities, and industry roundtable discussions. Workshops will empower participants with the knowledge, skills, and resources necessary to achieve employment, career advancement, financial stability, and digital competency.

The position promotes the full range of WIOA services, including career services, employment support, training opportunities, work-based learning, and supportive services, while ensuring that community and employer partnerships contribute to program enrollment, participant engagement, job placement, and employment retention.
1. Community Partnership Development and Outreach
bullets: Develop, establish, and maintain strategic partnerships with community-based organizations, educational institutions, government agencies, nonprofit organizations, and workforce partners throughout Lane County.
Serve as a primary point of contact and ambassador for WIOA services within the community.
Increase awareness of workforce services and expand community referrals into WIOA programs.
Educate community partners regarding WIOA eligibility requirements, available services, referral procedures, and enrollment processes.
Develop and implement outreach strategies that increase program visibility, participant enrollment, and access to workforce services.
Coordinate, facilitate, and participate in community workshops, workforce information sessions, resource fairs, hiring events, and other outreach activities.
Expand community-based service delivery through partnerships and collaborative initiatives.
Promote the full range of WIOA services, emphasizing career services, employment support, work-based learning, supportive services, and occupational training rather than tuition assistance alone.

sections.title: Qualifications
paras: The Community Partnership Manager is expected to contribute to measurable program outcomes through:
Performance expectations and individual goals will be established in alignment with program objectives, funding requirements, and organizational performance measures.

Local travel throughout Lane County is required to conduct employer engagement, community outreach, partnership meetings, workforce events, workshops, and other program activities. Occasional travel outside Lane County may be required for training, meetings, or organizational initiatives.
bullets: Bachelor's degree in business administration, workforce development, human services, education, communications, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Minimum of three years of experience in workforce development, community engagement, employer relations, business services, career services, training, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining professional partnerships with community organizations, employers, or workforce stakeholders.

Knowledge of workforce development programs, employment services, and community resources.
